MEET YOUR INSTRUCTOR认识周老师

A lifetime of practice.
A welcoming way to teach.功底深厚，教学亲切。

Huizhen Zhou is a National Health Qigong Champion and Tai Chi gold medalist with over 15 years of teaching experience. She has guided more than 1,000 students in China, from first-time learners to dedicated practitioners. Her approach is patient, demonstration-led, and adaptable: each person is invited to move at a comfortable pace.周慧珍老师是全国健身气功冠军、太极拳金牌获得者，拥有二十年以上教学经验，曾在中国指导一千余名学员。她注重动作示范、循序渐进与因人施教，让不同年龄、不同身体条件的学员都能找到适合自己的练习方式。

PROGRAMS特色课程

The art of movement, for every stage of life.一招一式，适合不同人生阶段。

01

Beginner Tai Chi初学者太极拳

An approachable introduction to mindful movement, posture, coordination, and graceful sequences.从基本姿势与动作入门，循序学习身体协调、舒展与太极动作。

02

Seated & Gentle Movement坐姿太极与舒缓练习

Chair-based and standing options for anyone who prefers gentler movement, including those with limited mobility or difficulty standing.提供坐姿与站姿选择，适合希望进行舒缓练习的人士，也可为行动不便或不便久站者调整动作。

03

Health Qigong & Breathing健身气功与呼吸练习

Gentle, flowing movement and breathing practices inspired by traditional Chinese wellness arts.结合八段锦等传统健身气功的舒缓动作与自然呼吸，注重身心放松。

04

Cultural & Community Workshops中华文化与社区体验课

Introductory workshops for libraries, schools, workplaces, cultural events, senior living communities, and local groups.面向图书馆、学校、企业、文化活动、养老社区及各类团体的太极与健身气功体验课。
